description:
Build unsigned XRP transactions ready for signing. Returns the unsigned transaction and fee details. After preparing, sign locally (xrp_sign) and broadcast via broadcast_signed_transaction.

Actions:
• native-coins: Build an unsigned native XRP transfer

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• native-coins: 60

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

destinationTag.description: Destination tag - commonly required when sending to an exchange address

feePriority.description: Fee priority tier - defaults to standard if omitted

sequence.description: Override the account sequence number (advanced use)
